fields.rationale: Most ORMs trade runtime performance for developer convenience. Paying reflection and expression compilation once per model on first access—and executing compiled delegates at native speed thereafter—delivers hand-coded ADO.NET throughput without boilerplate plumbing, making ArgentSea equally suited to latency-critical single-database workloads and large shard sets.
fields.statement: The framework must never be the bottleneck. Deliver ORM-level convenience at hand-optimized ADO.NET speed: compile property-to-data mapping into cached expression trees so reflection runs only once per model, favor stored procedures to cut parse/compile overhead and round-trips, and run shard queries concurrently across servers.
fields.title: Native-code performance, no abstraction tax

sources.label: Mapper performance — reflection once, then compiled expression trees
Performance feature — expression trees, stored procs, multi-threaded shard queries
